Eligibility for Docter Corse (for 2027 application)
Applicants must satisfy all the eligibility requirements for the Doctoral Degree
International Admission Programs which are mentioned below in articles (1) and (2). At the
same time, applicants must fulfill at least one of the eligibility requirements described in
articles (3) to (6). Those who have graduated from undergraduate universities in Japan
(including the University of Tokyo), or who are enrolled in universities in Japan (including
non-regular students such as research students) are not eligible for application through
International Admission Programs (Note 1).
(1) A person who neither has Japanese nationality nor resides in Japan during the period of
time from the online application’s start date until its deadline, i.e., during the
application period on T-cens (※1,2,3).
※ 1 Multiple citizenship holders with Japanese nationality and nationality from another
country (or countries) will, if unable to provide proof of relinquishment of Japanese
nationality by the time of arrival in Japan, be regarded as ineligible for the program.
※ 2 A person who resides in Japan (meaning a person who has a status of residence
provided for by the “Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act (Cabinet
Order No. 319 of 1951)” of Japan) during the application period on T-cens is not
eligible. However, the following students may be allowed to apply as an
exception. ・Non-Japanese international students who are temporarily enrolled at
the University of Tokyo during the application period on T-cens through an
exchange or short-term program with a partner institution, and who can provide
proof of their primary affiliation outside Japan. ・Should these students wish to
apply, they must submit documents showing that they are participating in a
program administered by the University of Tokyo.
※3 Those who neither have Japanese nationality nor reside in Japan during the
application period on T-cens but have “permanent resident”, “long-term resident”,
or “special permanent resident” residence status in Japan are in principle ineligible
to apply. However, individuals who correspond to Eligibilities (4) through (6)
below may be allowed to apply. For details, please contact the office of each
program no later than 2 weeks prior to the deadline for online application via T-
cens. Those who have graduated from universities with a bachelor’s degree, a
master’s degree or a doctoral degree in Japan (including the University of Tokyo)
are not eligible.
(2) A person with the language proficiency to take classes and receive research guidance in
English.
(3) A person who has been conferred, or is expected to be conferred by the day before the
admission date in April or October 2027, a degree equivalent to a master’s, doctoral or
a professional degree in a country other than Japan. A person who has graduated or who
is expecting to graduate from universities in Japan (including the University of Tokyo)
with a bachelor’s degree, master’s degree or doctoral degree is not eligible. (Notes 2, 3).
(4) A person who has passed or is expected to pass by the day before the admission date in
April or October 2027, a screening for fundamental ability for doctorate dissertation
research as specified in Article 16-2 of the Standards for Establishment of Graduate
Schools at a school abroad, shall be recognized by this graduate school as having abilities
at least equivalent to those who have a master’s degree. (Notes 3, 5).
(5) A person who has completed at least 16 years of academic education in a country other
than Japan, and has been engaged in research at a university, research institute or other
institution in a country other than Japan for at least 2 years, or is expected to have been
engaged in research for at least 2 years by the day before the admission date in April
or October 2027, and shall be recognized by this graduate school as having abilities at
least equivalent to those who have a master’s degree or a professional degree as a result
of the said research (Notes 3, 5).
(6) A person who is 24 years of age or older as of the day before the admission date in April
or October 2027, whom this graduate school has recognized, through individual
screening of entrance qualifications, as having abilities that are at least equivalent to a
master’s degree or a professional degree holder (Notes 3, 4, 5, 6).
Note 1 Japanese universities mentioned above are universities within the boundaries
of Japan and are as prescribed in Article 83 of the School Education Act.
Note 2 Those who have obtained a master’s, a professional degree, or its equivalent
from other Japanese universities and who reside outside Japan during the
application period on T-cens are eligible to apply to this program at the
discretion of the department they are applying to. Even in such cases, those
who have graduated from undergraduate universities in Japan (including the
University of Tokyo) are not eligible to apply.
Note 3 Although the admission date is scheduled to be on April 1 or October 1 2027,
it may be subject to change. The confirmed admission date will be announced
on our web site later.
Note 4 Those covered under Eligibility (6) above are those who are not covered under
Eligibility (3) through (5) above, but are recognized by this graduate school
through individual screening as having abilities at least equivalent to that of a
master’s degree or a professional degree holder.
Note 5 Those who wish to apply based on Eligibility (4), (5) or (6) must contact the
office of each program no later than 2 weeks prior to the deadline for online
application via T-cens, as the eligibility for application is confirmed
individually.
Note 6 Those who are recognized as having abilities that are at least equivalent to a
master’s degree or a professional degree holder through screening of entrance
qualifications will be permitted to apply and take the entrance examination.
